## 🎣 SDRF Compensation for a Fishing Household: Boats & Nets Lost

### PART 1 — SDRF Norms of Assistance (Fishery Sector)

The SDRF norms under **Section 9.2 of the Odisha SDMP 2019** (Item 7 — Fishery) prescribe the following for **repair/replacement of boats and nets damaged or lost** in a natural calamity:

| Asset | Damage Type | SDRF Assistance |
|---|---|---|
| **Boat** (Dugout-Canoe / Catamaran) | **Partially damaged** (repair) | **Rs. 4,100** per boat |
| **Boat** | **Fully damaged / lost** | **Rs. 9,600** per boat |
| **Net** | **Partially damaged** (repair) | **Rs. 2,100** per net |
| **Net** | **Fully damaged / lost** | **Rs. 2,600** per net |
| **Fish Seed Farm** | Input subsidy | **Rs. 8,200** per hectare |

📌 [Source: Odisha SDMP 2019, §9.2 — SDRF Items & Norms, Item 7: Fishery | **State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)**]

> ⚠️ **Important conditions attached:**
> - This assistance is **NOT provided** if the fisherman has already availed of any subsidy or assistance for the same calamity under **any other Government scheme**.
> - Loss must be **certified by the competent authority** designated by the State Government.
> - SDRF assistance is **state-funded** and disbursed automatically without needing GoI (NDRF) approval.

---

### PART 2 — Fani-Specific Relief Package (What Was Actually Disbursed)

The **Fani relief package** (from the `relief_package` table) records the following for affected households:

| Category | Districts Covered | Cash | Rice | Other |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Extremely severely affected HH | **Puri, parts of Khurdha** | **Rs. 2,000** | 50 kg | Polythene sheet |
| Severely affected HH | Khurdha | **Rs. 1,000** | One-month additional quota | Polythene sheet |
| Moderately affected HH | Cuttack, Kendrapada, Jagatsinghpur | **Rs. 500** | One-month additional quota | — |
| PM National Relief Fund – deceased | Odisha-wide | **Rs. 2,00,000** | — | Ex-gratia |
| PM National Relief Fund – seriously injured | Odisha-wide | **Rs. 50,000** | — | Ex-gratia |

📌 [Source: `relief_package` table, page 5 — Fani Relief Package 2019]

> ⚠️ **Key Observation:** The Fani-specific relief package recorded in the database **does not list a specific fisherman's boat/net line item** for Fani 2019. The package covered general household relief (cash + rice + polythene). **Sector-specific fishery SDRF norms** (Rs. 9,600 for boat; Rs. 2,600 for net) would apply via the SDRF route administered through respective District Collectors.

---

### PART 3 — Scale of Fishery Damage & Relief Context

Qdrant documents confirm the **enormous scale** of fishery damage in Odisha under prior cyclones (Phailin 2013 data cited for context):

> *"8,423 boats and 33,398 nets lost/damaged; 5,742 Ha of inland water bodies damaged — 44,806 fishermen households affected"* [Phailin RDNA 2013]

For **Fani 2019**, the affected fishermen communities in Puri and Khurdha (Chilika lagoon, marine fisheries) were similarly concentrated in the most severely affected districts. The **Puri DDMP** confirms the standard mechanism:

> *"Assistance to fisherman / fish seed farmers... are administered through the respective Collectors"* and *"Collectors have been instructed to disburse the ex-gratia assistance from the available cash"* [Puri DDMP 2017-18, §11.4; Odisha SDMP §9.4]

---

### PART 4 — Composite Summary: What a Fisherman Household Can Claim

| Component | SDRF Norm | Fani Package |
|---|---|---|
| **Fully lost boat** | Rs. 9,600 | Not a separate Fani line item |
| **Fully lost net** | Rs. 2,600 | Not a separate Fani line item |
| **Household cash relief** (Puri/Khurdha) | N/A | Rs. 2,000 (Fani-specific) |
| **Rice** | N/A | 50 kg (Fani-specific) |
| **Livelihood daily allowance** | Rs. 60/adult/day (up to 30 days, extendable) | — |
| **Fish seed farm input subsidy** | Rs. 8,200/ha | — |
| **Total SDRF max (boat + net, fully lost)** | **Rs. 12,200** | — |

> 🔑 **Bottom line:** A fishing household that lost **one boat and nets** is entitled under SDRF to claim up to **Rs. 9,600 (boat) + Rs. 2,600 (net) = Rs. 12,200** in immediate assistance, **plus Rs. 2,000 Fani cash + 50 kg rice** as general household relief if in Puri/Khurdha — totalling **up to Rs. 14,200 in direct cash/kind**. The SDRF fishery component is routed through District Collectors. No dedicated Fani fishery disbursement record exists in the available databases to confirm actual payment status for Fani 2019 specifically.
